provider: NASA HLS, distributed through Microsoft Planetary Computer
selection: 3 representative seasonal dates; shortlist of up to 12 passes by catalog cloud cover, ranked by minimum AOI QA-clear fraction. Not the complete daily archive.
qa_rule: Exclude Fmask nodata 255, bits 1/2/3/4, aerosol bits 6-7==3. Water retained. Negative index input reflectances excluded.
